 Show Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Why can't Arsenal make it easy on themselves?
 Robert 
 43 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It was a tight angle, but you at least expect Havertz to be hitting the target from there.
 61 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Fleetwood can't cope with Martin Odegaard. He lifts a ball into the box for Kai Havertz but he makes the wrong decision and puts it into the side netting. 
 109 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Bradford 2-0 Peterborough 
 Jake Beesley has done everything but score for Bradford tonight! He gets onto the ball into the box, dinks it onto his right foot and then curls a shot just over.
 20 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'This is the Arsenal performance that you expected' published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This is the Arsenal performance that you expected.
 Move the ball quickly, force the opposition backwards, spread them, and make them cover different distances. And, as soon as you lose the ball, win it back quickly.
 186 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 No matter what, Fleetwood have had their moment, a goal against the Champions of England. Many sides won't do that, so good on Fleetwood and enjoy this.
 Steven 
 421 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 It was the head of Rhys Bennett that Kai Havertz's strike bounced off. 
 That saved a certain goal. 
 101 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Odegaard has come in at half-time, and is playing like a quarterback in front. He's picking the ball up, it's all he's done, and it's his switch out to the left-hand side that causes the problems.
 And once the ball comes in from O'Neill, it's just a battle. The ball falls about, think who's going to get there, and Gyokeres just prods it past the goalkeeper.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 207 93 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Bradford 2-0 Peterborough 
 It's not clicking for Peterborough, that second goal has sunk them.
 Josh Feeney's pass goes straight out of play.
 22 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Martin Odegaard pings a perfect ball over to Max Dowman. He brings it down and forces Jay Lynch into the save, which he palms out to Kai Havertz. 
 He fires over from about two yards away but it somehow got a touch. 
 97 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Crispin McLean is the first to be shown a yellow card for a trip on Ceadach O’Neill. 
 124 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal look to be a lot slicker in this second half already, with Martin Odegaard pulling the strings in the middle. 
 Very, very tough for the League Two side now. 
 318 144 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Bradford 2-0 Peterborough 
 Meanwhile, Peterborough manager Robbie Savage has his hands on his hips. His side win a corner but don't do much with it.
 51 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal 
 And that is Viktor Gyokeres' first goal this season. 
 495 156 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal published at 21:12 GMT 21:12 GMT 
 Viktor Gyokeres (50 mins) 
 All square!
 Ceadach O’Neill hooks a dangerous ball into the mixer and Viktor Gyokeres misses his initial kick before somehow bundling it over the line while on the floor. 
 It's scruffy but Arsenal won't care one bit. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1579 1243 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Calm down people, the game isn’t over yet. And we see this all the time with Arsenal, all the possession, slow build up play, little to show for it. 
Fleetwood had only the one chance all half, born from an inexperienced young centre back being out-muscled. Only way is up.
 Peter 
 511 256 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 A reminder that the winners tonight will be through to the quarter-finals. 
 Plenty to play for. 
 219 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:10 GMT 21:10 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 Martin Odegaard is involved right away as he lifts a ball into the box but Jay Lynch is sharp off his line to collect. 
 145 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Bradford 2-0 Peterborough published at 21:09 GMT 21:09 GMT 
 Adam Phillips (67 mins) 
 Having just wasted a great chance, Adam Phillips makes amends!
 The substitute brilliantly wins the ball back, plays a one-two with Jake Beesley, and then unleashes from 20 yards out and sees his shot deflects off Lucca Mendonca and into the top corner.
 Bradford almost there!
 Image source, Getty Images 
 281 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Not many teams been able to say that they have restricted Arsenal' published at 21:09 GMT 21:09 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Fleetwood have restricted Arsenal to very little and not many teams over the past couple of years have been able to say that they have restricted Arsenal.
 It's a very promising first half, there's still a lot more work for them to do. We're only halfway through and judging by the last 10 minutes, I think the second half could be a long 45 minutes for Fleetwood. But they have done really well.
